summary.name: Milestones
summary.reason: Milestones are built out of your own practice history. A few logged sessions are what make the weekly targets fit the way you play instead of guessing at it.

perks.0: Weekly targets picked from how you actually practise
perks.1: Fame to claim every time you clear one
perks.2: A read on where the week went, category by category

duels.name: Duels
duels.reason: A duel is ranked: you and a stranger get the same exercise and the app's scoring decides. A few sessions in you know how the scoring hears you — that is when a match against somebody else is a fair one.

perks.0: Anonymous 1-on-1 matches on technique, fretboard and ear drills
perks.1: 24 hours to set your best run, as many tries as you like
perks.2: An ELO rating and a ranking to climb

guilds.name: Guilds
guilds.reason: A guild runs on people turning up for each other. A few levels in you have a routine of your own — that is the point where joining one does something for the rest of the guild too, not just for you.

perks.0: A chat with guitarists practising the same week as you
perks.1: A weekly challenge the whole guild clears together
perks.2: A shared stash and a crest your guild wears

commissions.name: Commissions
commissions.reason: Commissions are the way round the drop tables, so they wait until you have played the case game for a while. By then the last few models missing from your Dex are the hardest ones to pull — and that is exactly what the bench is for.

perks.0: Order any guitar or pedal still missing from your Dex
perks.1: Paid in Fame and the parts the instrument is made of
perks.2: Built stock, with every mod slot free for the mods in your stash
